WowUp is an AddOn management website that launched in late 2020. The managers provided are able to manage and auto-update World of Warcraft AddOns from multiple different sources such as WoWInterface, TukUI, GitHub repositories, Wago.io, and CurseForge. In February 2022, WowUp partnered up with Wago.io which led to WowUp's API access for CurseForge getting denied. Later, WowUp developed a new, separate manager with permission of Overwolf (CurseForge owners), separating the managers between the choice of Wago.io and CurseForge. Both managers are continued to be supported, giving players an option to update their AddOns through either website.

Woundwood is a powdery ingredient used by the Farstriders. The powder is made from dried leaves of woundwood tree. When mixed with liquid, it forms a numbing paste. When it was applied as a poultice, the pain was deadened temporarily, and one had time to escape to safety. It was also used by the groom Talvas for the injured horse Parley. When she was young, Sylvanas Windrunner wanted to use it on Rendris Salonar and Aravan Salonar for laughing at Lirath Windrunner, so added it to drinks at a party. Xal'atath's Bargain: Oblivion was a level 2 affix for Mythic+. It cycled weekly with the other Xal'atath's Bargain affixes until level 12, when they are replaced with Xal'atath's Guile. The group of players will want to avoid the enemies collecting the crystals as it increases their damage done by 10% with the buff. Instead the players will want to absorb the crystals as it provides a stacking buff for everyone in the group called the which increases their mastery by 2% (+2% per stack) and leech by 1% (+1% per stack). This affix was retired with the start of The War Within Season 2.

Xy Imports Offices is an area located within Tazavesh, the Veiled Market. It leads directly to Xy Imports Receiving. Just outside of the office is Xy'nell, who is attempting to recruit adventurers to sabotage his own cartel's operations, Cartel Xy. It is explained that this is not being done out of malice for the cartel, but because their overseer, Coordinator Xy'thir, has been running the area like a tyrant and murdered someone. With aid from adventurers, Xy'thir is captured by the Cartel Zo security team; and Xy'nell is appointed to replace him.
